answer: Randomized admission lottery via delay-resistant beacon. Each round derives an unpredictable seed from a later-revealed source, then routes applicants through a shuffled inlet queue; only the seed-selected subset gains voice that epoch. Because the seed is unknowable before commit, attackers cannot precompute which duplicate identities win, so expected yield per fake falls to the selection rate. An attacker must fund many full participation cycles to secure a whisper of influence, and the reveal timing makes grinding a spiral of retries costly without guaranteed payoff.
